snippet.title: Ars Moriendi | Tactical RPG | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Ars Moriendi is a muddy and tragedic tactical RPG set in a war-torn Europe of the late 19th century, where you control the fate of a brother and sister on opposite sides. Raise powerful heroes into martyrs, unleash modern weaponry on a fully-destructible battlefield, seek glory in death.

Wishlist on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3841100/Ars_Moriendi

Music by Ogan ( @ogagagan1562 )
Voice-Acting by (in order of appearance) Tâm Nguyên ( @arthurion98 ), Ester Simkova
